metadata.title: Fish curry with Ridge gourd | Bodo Recipe
metadata.description:
A simple yet delicious curry of Ridge Gourd locally known as Jinka in Bodo language cooked with fish tastes great during summers season when the vegetable is in abundance. This is the season when this vegetable is grown and found in abundance.
